capabilities: Run Pomodoro work and break timers from the status bar
Cycle between work, short break, and long break durations
Play built-in or custom audio notifications when timers complete
Auto-progress to the next timer in the cycle
Assign hotkeys to timer commands like start, pause, and reset
extras: Free and open source under the MIT license; full documentation is hosted outside the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in timer, so users tracking focus sessions with the Pomodoro technique have to leave their notes or use a separate app.
summary: Pomodoro timer that lives in the Obsidian status bar with click controls, hotkey commands, and optional audio notifications.
